name: privacy-taxonomy
description: Generate a validated Fides/Fideslang privacy data map from a repository's source code.

interface.shortDescription: Generate validated Fides privacy data maps
interface.longDescription: Scan repository schemas and models, classify personal data against the bundled Fideslang taxonomy, and generate a validated privacy data map.
